posts.cooked:
The expansion after Wrath of the Cosmos expansion will be the Girls Night Out expansion, which will feature 2 new female heroes that fit into the club scene. One of the two environments is actually a fake club, that an evil man has made to lure women and capture them all, so that way he can turn them into motherly figures rather than being a party goer. There is a villain named The Cougar, who actually gets bonuses to male heroes under the age of 25.

 If pre-ordered, it comes with 3 promo cards, featuring a new team made up entirely of women (including characters that are neither gender, but act as if they were a woman), featuring The Visionary, Parse, Omnitron-X and one of the new heroes named Temptress. The Temptress is actually a Maerynian that wears too short of a skirt and way too much make-up.
